name: forkpair_lim
description: Shared libc sub-project 1: the break stops at the HEAP_LIM cell ($FFF8), whatever the cell holds up to its seed; garbage above the seed reads as the seed; an exec'd program starts with the cell at its seed, the loader's $FFF8 lowered by the binder and libc_init below the library cores, which the test passes to the exec'd copy to compare; and both fork paths keep parent and child bytes above the limit separate.  On a kernel with the constant $FFF9 ceiling it prints FP LIM FAIL ceiling.
